stem: Root-zone EC is highest just before irrigation and lower after a complete irrigation event. Which interpretation is most appropriate?
choices: Water removal between events can concentrate dissolved ions, so timing relative to irrigation matters when comparing EC readings
The crop is proven deficient in nitrogen
EC should never change with water content
Pre-irrigation readings should always be deleted
rationale: Root-zone EC can shift as water content changes. Comparable sampling timing is important for useful trend interpretation.
